items.title: Borrow checker complains for closure inside loop if type not provided explicitly
items.body:
I have this code, for which borrow checker shows error:

https://play.rust-lang.org/?version=stable&mode=debug&edition=2018&gist=55d050b6f25410ce0e17ef9e844b048d

fn f1(v: &str) {
}

fn main() {
    let c = |v| f1(v);
    for _ in 0..1 {
        let s = String::new();
        c(&s);
    }
}

   |
10 |         c(&s);
   |         - ^^ borrowed value does not live long enough
   |

items.title: Mutably borrow one struct field while borrowing another in a closure
items.body:
I have a struct containing two fields and I want to modify one field (mutable borrow) using another field (immutable borrow), but I get an error from the borrow checker.

For instance, the following code:

struct Struct {
    field1: Vec<i32>,
    field2: Vec<i32>,
}

fn main() {
    let mut strct = Struct {
        field1: vec![1, 2, 3],
        field2: vec![2, 3, 4],
    };

    strct.field1.retain(|v| !strct.field2.contains(v));

    println!("{:?}", strct.field1);
}
